capitals.note: Capital "Maldarede, at 9°23′N 37°34′E, according to the hagiography of Tekle Haymanot"; "The kings of Damot, who bore the title motalami" resided there.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria lacks Damot). "positioned below the Blue Nile"; "Originally it lay south of the Abay River and west of the Muger River, and it extended east beyond the Muger as far as the Jamma River." No area figure on the page. The name 'Damot' is not in the gazetteer yet; the capital Maldarede (9.38 N, 37.57 E) is the centre.

ledger.note: 10th century: the kingdom of Damot forms. Infobox "c. 10th/13th century"; "Possibly formed in the 10th century". The page gives no year: 950 is a placeholder.

region.text: the land "positioned below the Blue Nile", south of the Abay and west of the Muger as far as the Jamma River

ledger.note: 13th century: Damot makes the Sultanate of Showa pay tribute. "Damot was a powerful state by the 13th century that forced the Sultanate of Shewa to pay tributes" (Showa page); the Damot page has it a "powerful state" forcing the Sultanate of Showa to pay tribute, no year. 1250 is a placeholder for the century.

region.text: the Sultanate of Showa, capital Walale in northern Hararghe

ledger.note: 1285: Ifat deposes the kings of Shewa, ending the tribute (bridge). "In 1285 Ali b. Wali Asma deposed the kings of Shewa"; the page does not say that the tribute to Damot ended then.

region.text: the Sultanate of Showa, capital Walale in northern Hararghe

ledger.note: 1316/7: Amda Seyon conquers Damot. "Damot was conquered by Emperor Amda Seyon in 1316/7"; the infobox says c. 1316; his own chronicle: "all the people of Damot [came] into my hands; its king, its princes, its rulers, and its people". The year is the page's but is given as 1316/7.

ledger.note: 1316: the kingdom of Damot ends. The Damot page adds that the land was overrun by the Macha Oromo around the 16th century under Mula'ata Lubas (1586-1594).

certainty.note: Described only by rivers (Abay, Muger, Jamma); no boundary.

sources.title: Kingdom of Damot
sources.note: Infobox c. 10th/13th century to c. 1316; location south of the Abay; capital Maldarede; tribute from Shewa in the 13th century; conquest by Amda Seyon in 1316/7.

sources.title: Sultanate of Showa
sources.note: 896 to 1285-86, Makhzumi dynasty, capital Walale in northern Hararghe, tribute to Damot, Ifat in 1285.

notes: New dossier: Cliopatria lacks Damot. Pages opened: Kingdom of Damot, Sultanate of Showa (2). Start (950) and the 13th-century tribute (1250) are century placeholders at confidence 1; the end (1316/7) is the page's. 'Damot' is a region name the ethiopian-empire dossier (af-01-b) already uses for its 1316 gain; the gazetteer lacks it (see gazetteer_names_needed: the land south of the Abay/Blue Nile bend, west of the Muger River to the Jamma River, centred on Maldarede about 9.38 N 37.57 E, in Oromia/Shewa-Wellega). The tribute relation between Damot (south-west) and the Sultanate of Showa (north-east Hararghe) is the pages' statement; the geography is odd and a gap-filler should check a Damot source. Counterpart: sultanate-of-shewa (written in this batch).
